scope: CROSS-32 through CROSS-42 only (G12-50 through G12-60); all top5 original G33 nominees for each were actually visually reviewed, not merely scored.

transform.kind: fixed uniform scale and translation supplied by parent registration
transform.cropping_and_resampling: Diagnostic-only bicubic warp of original full-body frames, then fixed ROI and isotropic Lanczos downscale. Source frames and production assets unchanged.

method: Direct side-by-side visual inspection of the target and all five nominees at the same fixed similarity transform, using actual cached original RGB frames. Visible hand topology, arm direction, head/face and costume geometry determine rejection; differing subtitles/background are ignored. Crops preserve all dark character pixels horizontally in the displayed height.

limitations: This review covers five nominated candidates per target, not a fresh per-pixel all-to-all registration of every G33 pose. The parent nomination evaluated all 68.
A negative complete-half-body verdict does not deny shared head/torso or usable subparts; it preserves the distinct visible hand/arm work.
No author-cel identity, hidden-pixel recovery, automatic final-art reuse, or whole-video completeness is claimed.
No source, old cel, frozen reuse manifest or previous audit was modified.
